blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—A former Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) official on Thursday said 25 percent of the budget allocated for infrastructure projects in the 2025 General Appropriations Act (GAA) are given as “commitments” to certain proponents, including senators. This was according to former DPWH Regional Director Gerard Opulencia, who testified as a prosecution witness before the Sandiganbayan Fifth Division on Thursday during the continuation of Sen. Jinggoy Estrada’s bail hearing for a plunder case. “Question 64 of your judicial affidavit states the method by which the commitment is computed.
